$comment: SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG contribution parameters. These change on statutory schedules — every block must be reconciled against the current circulars (see confidence flags).

legalBasis: RA 11199 (Social Security Act of 2018) Sec 4 — 15% is the final scheduled step, in force since 2025
sss.notes: Verified for 2026 (Aug 4, 2026): 15% of the monthly salary credit — employer 10% / employee 5%; MSC ₱5,000–₱35,000; the portion above ₱20,000 funds the mandatory provident fund (WISP/MPF). Self-employed, voluntary, and OFW members pay the full 15% themselves. The small employer-paid EC premium (₱10 below ₱15,000 MSC, ₱30 at or above) follows the EC program schedule — confirm exact EC pesos against the current SSS table.

legalBasis: RA 11223 (Universal Health Care Act) Sec 10 — 5% final scheduled rate
PhilHealth announcement of the CY2026 rate (via Philippine Information Agency)
philhealth.notes: Verified for CY2026 (Aug 4, 2026): 5% of monthly basic salary, floor ₱10,000 / ceiling ₱100,000 (premium ₱500–₱5,000), split equally between employer and employee. Self-employed direct contributors pay the full 5% of declared income.

legalBasis: HDMF Circular 460 — maximum fund salary ₱10,000 effective Feb 2024
pagibig.notes: Verified for 2026 (Aug 4, 2026): employees earning ≤₱1,500/month contribute 1%, otherwise 2%; employers always 2%; both computed on a fund salary capped at ₱10,000 (max ₱200 + ₱200 = ₱400). Self-employed members contribute on the same schedule based on declared income, shouldering both shares.
